description.value: The Hive is a bouldering-focused climbing gym occupying a two-storey building in Vancouver's Industrial Avenue corridor. It is part of a multi-location BC and Manitoba chain and is notable as one of two Hive branches within walking distance of each other on the same street. For touring cyclists looking for an active rest day, it offers a drop-in climbing experience in an urban industrial setting.

raw_osm.description: Bouldering gym. Note there are two The Hive locations within a short walking distance of eachother
raw_osm.name: The Hive

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is almost entirely waiver flow UI and location-selector navigation; the /amenities/accessibility subpage returned only 'Hive New_production' with no usable content, leaving nearly all amenity fields unverifiable. OSM tags confirm an active fee-based bouldering gym (leisure=sports_centre, sport=climbing) at 520 Industrial Ave, and the website's location selector corroborates the address. No bike parking, showers, cafe, water, or any other cycling-relevant amenity is mentioned anywhere in the fetched content.
concerns: OSM description explicitly notes two The Hive locations within short walking distance of each other on Industrial Avenue (520 and 670); the OSM record for the Heights branch may create a near-duplicate listing.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is active and legitimate, but the website content was too sparse to verify any of the required cycling-friendly amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms); a manual check is needed before listing. Additionally, a nearly identical second Hive location at 670 Industrial Ave (Vancouver Heights) exists within walking distance and may warrant a deduplication decision.
